intro: A plate of nasi goreng cina has about 550 kcal. Most of the calories come from the rice and oil, with a bit of protein from the egg and meat.
diet: Yes. Nasi goreng cina is one of the lighter fried rice options because it doesn't have much chilli or santan. But protein is usually low and there's a lot of rice. So you get hungry again quickly even though calories are quite high. Add protein and vegetables, and cut the rice.
tips: Ask for extra egg or chicken, and less rice.
Order a plate of stir-fried vegetables to share.
Ask for less oil. Most shops can do it.

swap.name: Steamed chicken rice without skin + vegetable soup
swap.why: More protein, less oil, and you still get your rice.

faq.q: What's the difference between nasi goreng cina and nasi goreng kampung?
faq.a: Nasi goreng cina is lighter, using egg, garlic and light soy sauce. Nasi goreng kampung uses chilli, belacan and ikan bilis.
It depends on the shop. Choose a halal-certified or Muslim-owned shop.

faq.q: How do I make nasi goreng cina that's not mushy?
faq.a: Use cold rice, high heat, and don't add too much soy sauce.
